QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Finally Meeting the Old Woman
QuestInfo.0: You've finally met Sanaan, the old woman who sent you the letter. She thanks you profusely for finding her and tells you about her trip to Abrup, the time she spent waiting in her cabin, and the story of why she sent you that letter at Skuas, all in the interest of finding her missing granddaughter.
